description: Read Terraform / OpenTofu (HCL or .tf.json, several files one after another) and turn the resources that carry requests — load balancers, gateways, compute, queues, caches, databases… — into an architecture with their cloud technology and price, connected, and simulate it like archsim_simulate (throughput, latency, bottleneck, cost per hour, queues). Networking, IAM and DNS are counted, not drawn. Connections and load are DEDUCED (Terraform says dependencies, not request paths, and no traffic): each assumption comes in notes. Returns the archsim document too, to edit and pass to archsim_simulate.

aiReqPerSec.description: Requests/s entering through AI sources, as in archsim_simulate. Default 0

terraform.description: The .tf (HCL) or .tf.json content; for a project in several files, paste them one after another

name: archsim_from_terraform
title: Architecture from Terraform, simulated
